l7r/diagram/labels/hand_sheet.py::subjec.note: the beside seat stays level for a turned feature in two branches. In the holder branch, `inner, beside = [(holder.poly, _squared(holder))], [(box, False)]`, a turned rect holder's name is turned inside it but set level beside it, off the upright box. In the single-block branch, `... if len(blocks) >= 2 else [(box, False)]`, the same happens. The page says "a caption naming a turned feature is drawn at that feature's own angle and seated off its turned edge" and "not off an upright box around it". The claim also says "beside it or inside it". Either seat beside a squared holder or a lone block at its own angle, or narrow the claim to the cases the code turns
